title: Principal Software Engineer - Vector Search - Elasticsearch
cleaned_description: div class= content-intro p Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. /p /div h2 What is the role /h2 p We re looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search team. This globally-distributed team of expert engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principal software engineering role that focuses on enhancing the vector similarity search functionality within Elasticsearch, covering the design and implementation of new vector search features, enhancements to existing vector search functionality, and resolving bugs. /p p Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements. /p h2 strong What You Will Be Doing /strong /h2 ul li Lead initiatives within a href= https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/ target= _blank Elasticsearch /a to produce an industry-leading vector database offering, supplying unparalleled speed and relevance in search. /li li Contribute to Elasticsearch full time, building new search features and fixing intriguing bugs, all while making the code easier to understand. Sometimes you ll need to invent a new algorithm or data structure. Or find one and implement it. title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Delta
cleaned_description: p P-1127 /p p At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world s toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world s best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high value challenges that are central to their own missions. /p p Our engineering teams build highly technical products that fulfill real, important needs in the world. We develop and operate one of the largest scale software platforms. The fleet consists of millions of virtual machines, generating terabytes of logs and processing exabytes of data per day. At our scale, we regularly observe cloud hardware, network, and operating system faults, and our software must gracefully shield our customers from any of the above. /p p The Delta DML team owns the core write-path operations for Delta Lake, the open-source storage layer behind the Databricks Lakehouse. Our mission is to deliver industry-leading performance and a seamless user experience at massive scale, with most data written in Databricks flowing through our platform. nbsp; We drive performance innovations like Low Shuffle Merge and Deletion Vectors and actively contribute to open source efforts to unify Delta and Iceberg formats. /p p We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Staff Software Engineer to join our backend team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining robust backend systems that power Databricks workspaces. You will build the next-generation platform for serving workspace assets, ensuring high QPS, low latency, reliable, and performant systems, proactively addressing the future growth challenges. Additionally, as a senior member of the team, you will provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers, contributing to the overall improvement of team coding practices and system designs. /p p strong The Impact you will have: /strong /p ul li Solve real business needs at large scale by applying your software engineering. /li li Low level systems debugging, performance measurement, and optimization on large production clusters. /li li Build architecture design, influence product roadmap, and take ownership and responsibility over new projects. /li li Introduce tools to allow greater automation and operability of services. /li li Use your deep experience to help prevent and investigate production issues. /li li Plan and lead complicated technical projects that work with several teams within the company. /li li Contribute as a technical team lead by mentoring others, lead sprint planning, delegating work and assignments to team members and participate in project planning. /li /ul p strong What we look for: /strong /p ul li 15+ years industry experience building and supporting large-scale distributed systems. /li li Comfortable working towards a multi-year vision with incremental deliverables. /li li Motivated by delivering customer value and impact. /li li Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures and their real-world use cases. /li li Experience driving company initiatives towards customer satisfaction. /li li BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or related majors, or equivalent experience. /li /ul p nbsp; /p div class= content-conclusion p strong About Databricks /strong /p p span style= font-family: arial, sans-serif; Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on a href= https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks LinkedIn /a , a href= https://x.com/databricks X /a , a href= https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks YouTube /a , and a href= https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en Instagram /a . br br strong Benefits br br /strong /span At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field. /p p strong Responsibilities /strong : /p p You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS in C/C++/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. title: Founding Engineer (Tech Lead)
original_description:
The Context

Banks still run their most critical, regulated work by hand; reading letters and emails, re-keying data between systems, chasing down missing info. It's the kind of work that's too important to get wrong and too tedious for anyone to want to do.

Porters fixes this. Our AI agents run these regulated processes end to end, with the audit trails and security banks actually require, so the work moves at the speed customers expect instead of the speed a backlog allows.

We're just over a year old and already live with real customers, growing the product quickly, and were named Fintech of the Year 2026. The goal is to build the operating system for autonomous banking. We're backed by Earlybird, one of Europe's oldest venture firms, and Seedcamp, who wrote first checks into Revolut, Wise, and UiPath.

The Mission

You'll own the outcomes. You take an ambiguous business problem and turn it into clear requirements, a design with clear business rationale, sequenced work, and a realistic estimate, build the hardest parts yourself, and multiply a team of mid-level engineers with well-defined, extensible work and the reviews that keep quality high. You stay an IC at heart while making the work legible, sized, and worth doing.

This job is in person in Zurich, or remote in Barcelona or Berlin.

Your responsibilities

  • Deliver the highest-risk work yourself: Be the IC where it matters. Personally engineer the most complex, business-critical components, from cross-service logic to the boundary where AI outputs become deterministic, auditable actions, and set the technical bar for the team as you go.

  • Turn business goals into shipped projects: Take an ambiguous problem and own it through to delivery, defining requirements, a design that starts from customer impact and takes the highest-ROI path whether it's make or buy, sequenced work, estimates, and clear engineering acceptance criteria a team can execute with minimal churn.

  • Design complex systems that don’t break down in 12 months: Architect entire systems so the likely next requirement plugs in cleanly through configuration or a new adapter, keeping components reusable and loosely coupled, separating business logic from shared services, and maintaining a single authoritative, append-only source of truth for critical data - including consideration of make-or-buy options.

  • Scale the team's autonomy and quality: Set decision thresholds so engineers self-serve low-stakes calls, define sanctioned paths for experimenting with regulated data, and spread understanding of our systems to cut key-person risk. Settle design in review, then build the road to production: CI/CD with quality gates, automated migrations, and systems that report their own health.

  • Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request, and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters made my day!”?

Your profile

  • Experience: Typically 8+ years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus.

  • IC strength: A hands-on builder who ships the hard things, and who naturally thinks in business outcomes, work packages, ROI, and extensibility.

  • Project definition: Proven ability to write requirements and designs from business context, break them into estimated, sequenced work, and drive a project to completion in a tool like Linear.

  • Technical proficiency: Deep proficiency in Python is mandatory, with strong command of REST API design, relational data modeling, and layered, service-oriented architecture.

  • AI-native: Real experience building LLM/agentic tooling, and understanding how to bound probabilistic output with deterministic code.

  • Natural leader: You lift the people around you through design review, coaching, and clear direction, and you enjoy doing it.

  • Going the extra mile: Be part of a high-growth phase, where we move fast and expect focused intensity. 9-to-5 is not the mode we work in, if you want to build something that matters with a team that ships, we are your people.

What We Offer

  • Ownership of whole product areas: Latitude to shape what we build and how we scope, sequence, and ship it, with a team to build it with.

  • Founder collaboration: Work directly with founders who have built and scaled fintech and analytics products before.

  • We win and lose together as a team: We expect people to leave their comfort zone on a daily basis, however, we work together as a team and support each other at any time.

  • Growth: A dedicated development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up.

  • Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together.

Our stack

  • Core Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 in a strict four-layer architecture, exposed as separate internal and external APIs.

  • Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running.

  • AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity.

  • Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability.

  • Platform: A multi-tenant AWS environment on ECS Fargate with strict per-tenant network and data isolation (VPC, NACLs, WAF), CloudFront + Cognito (Google SSO/JWT) and API Gateway (IAM) at the edge, defined as code in CloudFormation across dev/staging/prod accounts.

  • Frontend: React single-page app for the internal workbench.

  • Dev Workflow: uv, Ruff, ty, pytest (unit, integration, property-based), Docker, GitHub Actions, and heavy use of Agentic IDEs to accelerate feature shipping.

title: Engineering Intern / Traineeship
original_description:
Imagine this. You are helping build the electronic foundation behind advanced aerospace and defence systems, making sure every component, symbol, footprint, and schematic detail is accurate before it reaches hardware.

As an Engineering Intern, you will work hands-on with Altium Designer and support our electronics engineers in creating and maintaining high-quality PCB design data. This is an opportunity to move beyond university projects and work with real engineering hardware where precision and attention to detail matter.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

  • Create, review, and maintain electronic components, schematic symbols, footprints, and library data in Altium Designer
  • Read schematics and component datasheets to ensure design data accurately reflects manufacturer specifications
  • Support engineers with PCB design activities and help maintain clean, consistent, and reliable component libraries
  • Check existing components for errors, inconsistencies, and missing information before they make their way into hardware
  • Help improve library management, component validation, and engineering workflows
  • Use scripting and automation where useful to make repetitive checks faster and more reliable

Requirements

  • Currently studying toward a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field, or recently graduated
  • Hands-on experience with Altium Designer through university projects, personal PCB designs, or previous internships
  • Comfortable with schematic capture, library editors, and creating your own symbols and footprints
  • Ability to read schematics and datasheets, with a solid understanding of packages, pinouts, passive components, and common ICs
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to technical work
  • Good written and spoken English
  • Experience with Altium 365 or another managed library environment is a plus
  • Familiarity with IPC-7351 footprint standards is an advantage
  • Basic Python or similar scripting experience for automation and bulk checks is a plus
  • Exposure to component lifecycle or obsolescence management is an advantage

Who You Are

You are curious, precise, and hands-on. You enjoy getting into the details and understand that a tiny mistake in a component library can become a very real hardware problem later. You work methodically, ask questions when something does not look right, and are excited to learn from experienced engineers while taking real ownership from day one.

We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking amp; financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally. /p p strong The Role: nbsp; br /strong /p p We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own the classical cryptography architecture of our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration products, targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. You will be the senior authority for this classical and hybrid layer, working alongside our PQC architecture leadership. The role demands fluency on both sides of the transition: deep classical mastery combined with a solid working command of the post-quantum algorithms and standards the products are built around. /p p strong Responsibilities /strong : /p p You will own the architecture and implementation strategy of the classical cryptographic functions of the product line: symmetric ciphers and modes (AES/GCM and beyond), hash functions (SHA-2/SHA-3, HMAC/KDF constructions), RSA/ECC offload, and true random number generation and entropy architecture (SP 800-90A/B/C). You have deep command of symmetric and asymmetric primitives, modes of operation, key management and entropy generation, and you have taken cryptographic subsystems through FIPS 140-3 or Common Criteria evaluation. You also bring a solid working knowledge of the NIST post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) and their deployment constraints: you do not need to be a lattice specialist, but you must be able to architect hybrid schemes with one. /p p You understand the practical constraints of deployed security infrastructure (HSMs, PKI, TLS and IPsec ecosystems) and how hybrid classical/post-quantum schemes are standardised and deployed in practice. You write precise specifications, guide implementers effectively, and make sound architecture decisions under real-world interoperability constraints. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage. /p ul li Proven architect of classical cryptographic subsystems with certification experience (FIPS 140-3, CAVP, Common Criteria) /li li Practical knowledge of hybrid classical/PQC schemes, crypto agility and key-management architecture, with working command of the NIST PQC standards /li /ul p strong Preferred Qualifications: br /strong /p p You believe that quantum-safe security is only as strong as the classical foundations it stands on. title: Product Engineer
original_description:
The Context

Banks still run their most critical, regulated work by hand; reading letters and emails, re-keying data between systems, chasing down missing info. It's the kind of work that's too important to get wrong and too tedious for anyone to want to do.

Porters fixes this. Our AI agents run these regulated processes end to end, with the audit trails and security banks actually require, so the work moves at the speed customers expect instead of the speed a backlog allows.

We're just over a year old and already live with real customers, growing the product quickly, and were named Fintech of the Year 2026. The goal is to build the operating system for autonomous banking. We're backed by Earlybird, one of Europe's oldest venture firms, and Seedcamp, who wrote first checks into Revolut, Wise, and UiPath.

The Mission

You'll own features in their entirety. Self-standing or with guidance of founders and fellow engineers, you turn a clear problem statement into a strong design and build, test, and ship new features that directly enable our customers. You integrate features across our layered stack, from the API to the data plane, and carry them all the way to production.

This job is in person in Zurich, or remote in Barcelona or Berlin.

Your responsibilities

  • Ship features end-to-end: Deliver complete vertical slices across the stack, from the API layer to the data model, carried through to running in production.

  • Grow what the platform does for banks: Build the services Porters performs for banks: Extend the capabilities of our agentic platform such as case handling, customer matching, AI tool integrations, data enrichment, or keeping humans in the loop.

  • Deliver features that hold together as a system: Design endpoints, contracts, and interfaces that work together, ensuring features integrate cleanly towards one bigger outcome.

  • Ensure your work is reliable: Own design, development, tests, and deployment, so what reaches production is proven to work.

  • Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters, made my day”.

Your profile

  • Experience: Around 4 years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus.

  • Product thinking: You naturally understand why you’re building something, not just focusing on how to build.

  • Quality focus & individual problem solving: Given a clear problem, you reliably produce a clean algorithm, a sensible data model, a well-structured service. You treat tests and observability as part of the feature, and right-size rigor to risk. You are comfortable in a regulated fintech environment where precision matters.

  • Technical proficiency: Proficiency in Python is mandatory, along with REST API development, an ORM, and relational databases.

  • AI-native: You've worked with, or are eager to work with, LLM/agentic tooling, and understand how to bound probabilistic output with deterministic code.

  • Collaboration and eagerness to learn: You thrive on direction, review, and challenge, take feedback well, and want to grow into larger scopes. You are eager to learn every day.

  • Going the extra mile: Be part of a high-growth phase, where we move fast and expect focused intensity. 9-to-5 is not the mode we work in, if you want to build something that matters with a team that ships, we are your people.

What We Offer

  • Ownership from day one: Real features running in production at major financial institutions, with the trust to carry them there yourself.

  • Founder collaboration: Work directly with founders who have built and scaled fintech and analytics products before.

  • We win and lose together as a team: We expect people to leave their comfort zone on a daily basis, however, we work together as a team and support each other at any time.

  • Growth: A dedicated development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up.

Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together.

Our stack

  • Core Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 in a strict four-layer architecture, exposed as separate internal and external APIs.

  • Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running.

  • AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity.

  • Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability.

  • Platform: A multi-tenant AWS environment on ECS Fargate with strict per-tenant network and data isolation (VPC, NACLs, WAF), CloudFront + Cognito (Google SSO/JWT) and API Gateway (IAM) at the edge, defined as code in CloudFormation across dev/staging/prod accounts.

  • Frontend: React single-page app for the internal workbench.

  • Dev Workflow: uv, Ruff, ty, pytest (unit, integration, property-based), Docker, GitHub Actions, and heavy use of Agentic IDEs to accelerate feature shipping.

title: VP of Engineering
original_description:
About the Role

As VP of Engineering, you will be responsible for building, scaling, and operating a high-performing software engineering organization capable of reliably delivering Neural Concept’s ambitious product and technology roadmap.

You will turn product vision into software reality, while ensuring our teams and culture scale sustainably — in quality, velocity, and people development.

What you will do

Own engineering execution and delivery

  • Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery across product and platform initiatives

  • Translate product and technical strategy into realistic plans, milestones, and commitments

  • Identify risks early and manage trade-offs transparently

Structure the engineering organization

  • Evolve team structures, ownership boundaries, and collaboration models as we scale

  • Build and coach engineering managers and tech leads

  • Continuously adapt the organization to match company growth

Build strong and modern engineering processes

  • Establish lightweight, effective development processes that scale without bureaucracy

  • Leverage the best of AI technologies to amplify our impact while maintaining small, agile teams

  • Define and track the right engineering metrics

Guarantee technical quality, reliability, and security in practice

  • Partner with the CTO to uphold architectural principles and long-term technical health

  • Drive pragmatic approaches to technical debt, qulity testing, and operational excellence

  • Collaborate with GTM and deployment teams to guarantee smooth, secure deployments across diverse customer scaling scenarios

Collaborate closely with leadership and customers

  • Work together with Product, Research, Deployment, and Leadership

  • Represent engineering in cross-functional and customer-facing discussions

  • Act as a key partner to the CTO, providing clear signals on execution, risk, and org health

Who you are

You are a senior engineering leader who combines strong technical judgment with operational excellence and a deep understanding of how organizations scale. You are product-minded, pragmatic, think in systems and understand how outcomes derive from how people work together.

Proven experience leading software engineering organizations at scale

  • Experience scaling teams, at least x2 and 50+ engineers

  • Experience managing managers and tech leads

  • A track record of managing delivery in fast-growing, low-process environments

Strong technical credibility

  • Broad understanding of modern software architecture, infrastructure, and security

  • Deep understanding about modern AI technology for software engineering

  • Ability to engage deeply with engineers on design, trade-offs, and reliability

  • Comfort operating in AI- and data-intensive product environments

Product mindset and pragmatism

  • Ability to balance speed, quality, and long-term sustainability

  • User-first and product minded

  • Calm decision-making under pressure

  • Outcomes-focused, and not perfectionist

A people-first leadership mindset

  • High empathy and strong communication skills

  • Commitment to growing others and building healthy teams

Drive and ownership

  • Willingness to take responsibility and make hard calls

  • Track record of inspiring others and building confidence in high-uncertainty environments

What You Get

  • Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

title: Cybersecurity Architect - Zero Trust
original_description:
About cogify group

cogify was founded in Switzerland in 2018 and today combines expertise in consulting, AI, software engineering, cybersecurity and digital products.

We are expanding our cybersecurity capabilities and are looking for a Cybersecurity Architect with a strong focus on Zero Trust who understands complex IT environments and can translate security requirements into practical, implementable solutions.

Your Mission

As a Cybersecurity Architect, you work at the interface between business, security, technology and delivery.

You understand the challenges our customers face, assess existing environments and identify where security needs to evolve.

You combine consulting skills with strong technical expertise – from the first assessment and target architecture through technology selection and implementation together with our engineering teams.

You ask the right questions, challenge existing assumptions and communicate confidently with stakeholders from management to engineering teams.

Requirements

  • Assess existing IT and security environments and identify risks, gaps and improvement opportunities
  • Design Zero Trust and enterprise security target architectures
  • Develop practical security roadmaps and implementation concepts
  • Advise customers on security architecture, Zero Trust strategy and technology selection
  • Design solutions across IAM, ZTNA, SASE, network segmentation, cloud and endpoint security
  • Evaluate security technologies, products and licensing models against customer requirements
  • Translate business, security and compliance requirements into technically implementable solutions
  • Lead security workshops and architecture discussions with customers
  • Support implementation together with cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, DevOps and software engineers
  • Help shape and further develop cogify’s cybersecurity offering

Your Profile

  • Experience in cybersecurity architecture, security engineering, cybersecurity consulting or a comparable role
  • Strong understanding of Zero Trust architectures, technologies and principles
  • Good knowledge of frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207, CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model or comparable approaches
  • Strong knowledge of areas such as IAM, ZTNA, SASE, network security, segmentation, cloud security and access control
  • Experience designing or implementing enterprise security solutions
  • Ability to evaluate security technologies and select appropriate solutions for specific requirements
  • Strong understanding of enterprise networks, identity, authentication and cloud environments
  • Ability to translate complex security topics into clear decisions and practical solutions
  • Confident communication with both business and technical stakeholders
  • Independent, pragmatic and quality-focused way of working
  • Fluent English or German is required

Nice to Have

  • Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, ISSAP or comparable qualifications
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike or similar technologies
  • Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud
  • Experience in regulated or security-sensitive environments
  • German, French or other languages in addition to your primary working language

Benefits

At cogify, cybersecurity doesn’t end with an assessment or presentation.

You work directly with customers on real security challenges and stay involved when architecture becomes implementation.

The role combines cybersecurity consulting, architecture and technology, while giving you the opportunity to work closely with our engineering teams and actively shape a growing cybersecurity capability.

We offer a competitive salary, a flexible working environment, modern technologies and the opportunity to take real ownership of your work.

We are looking for people who ask good questions, understand complex systems and want to build security solutions that work in practice.

Sound like you? We look forward to meeting you.

title: AI Engineer
original_description:
Join our Data & Analytics team at Crypto Finance, headquartered in the Prime Tower in Zurich. Your primary mandate is pushing the company’s AI strategy forward: identifying use cases across departments, engineering production-grade AI and automation solutions, and helping to build the firm's AI governance practice. You will also contribute to the data platform that underpins Finance, Operations, and Risk reporting, since AI work at our company sits directly on top of that platform. 

This is a hybrid role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and an IDE. The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on. You will be expected to push back on bad use cases as much as you ship good ones. 

What you will do: 

AI & Automation Engineering 

  • Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle. 
  • Engineer production data solutions: Deterministic automations, AI agents, RAG systems over internal documents, structured extraction pipelines. 
  • Build the firm's "innovation lab" environment where new use cases can be prototyped and evaluated. 
  • Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. 

AI Governance and Inventory 

  • Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. 
  • Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. 
  • Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives proposed elsewhere in the company; advise on scope, risk, and design choices. 

Data Engineering and Platform 

  • Contribute to ELT pipelines on the Dagster + SQLMesh + dlt stack, primarily where AI & automation use cases require new data sources or transformations. 
  • Build the data substrate that AI workloads consume; feature views, document indexes, and structured event tables.  
  • Maintain infrastructure as code in Git with proper review and deployment standards. 

 

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of relevant experience. We are flexible on title, could be AI engineer, analytics engineer with AI focus, or data engineer who is pivoted to AI. What matters is shipped work. 
  • Demonstrable production experience with LLM applications: at minimum structured extraction with LLMs, and agentic patterns (tool use, multi-step workflows). You can describe what failed and what you learned. 
  • Strong Python; comfortable building production ready code, not just notebooks. 
  • Working knowledge of evaluation discipline for LLM applications (eval sets, regression tests, observability), conceptual understanding of retrieval, and how to handle hallucination. 
  • Familiarity with at least one orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and one transformation framework (SQLMesh, dbt). 
  • Solid SQL (window functions, joins, query design). 
  • Cloud experience, ideally GCP and BigQuery. 
  • Genuine curiosity about regulated environments and the discipline they require. 
  • Professional proficiency in English (German is a plus). 
  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss permit or EU/EFTA citizenship). 

Equally important is how you think: 

  • You reach for the simplest thing that works. Boring SQL before vector search. Rules before agents. You can explain why. 
  • You are comfortable saying "this is not an AI problem" when the right answer is a dashboard, a process fix, or a deterministic script. 
  • You can run a stakeholder workshop and write production code in the same week. 
  • You take documentation, evaluation, and audit trails seriously, not as overhead. 

Nice to have: 

  • Prior exposure to regulated financial services, crypto, or comparable model-risk environments. 

What we are not looking for: 

  • "Prompt engineers" with no production experience. 
  • Pure data engineers using this posting to pivot into AI without prior LLM work. 
  • Strategists or generalist "AI enthusiasts." This is a builder role. 

Benefits

  • Be part of an international, fast-paced blockchain and fintech team led by experienced professionals
  • Shape the future of finance while working at the cutting edge of B2B digital asset solutions
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with flat hierarchies
  • Take on meaningful responsibility with room for learning and professional growth
  • Gain deep industry insights and make a tangible impact
  • Join regular company-wide meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and team events
  • Enjoy a modern and central workplace in Zurich with top-tier infrastructure

Our culture

At the heart of our company, we prioritize:

  • Innovation and Continuous Learning
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit and Flat Hierarchies
  • Values such as Excellence, Delivery, Ownership, Passion, and Unity

Please note:

  • We do not accept CVs from recruiting or staffing agencies.
  • Due to the Swiss/German labor legislation, we can only accept applicants who have the right to work in Switzerland or Germany (are in possession of a Swiss/German work permit or are EU/EFTA citizens). All other applications will not be considered.
  • If this is the position for you, and you have a Swiss/German work permit and/or EU citizenship, please send us your complete application, incl. cover letter, CV, and references.

title: Scientific Data Architect - Basel, Switzerland
original_description:
About TetraScience

TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. We help the world’s leading life sciences firms turn fragmented scientific data into AI-native assets and scientific workflows that accelerate discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience’s growing ecosystem of strategic partners includes NVIDIA, Databricks, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft.

In connection with your candidacy, you will be asked to carefully review “The Tetra Way,” authored by our CEO, Patrick Grady; it is impossible to overstate the importance of this document, and you should take it literally as you decide whether our mission, culture, and expectations are right for you.

Who You Are

You are a product-minded, outcome-obsessed driver of technical scientific solutions.

You a high velocity self-starter. You refuse to let uncertainty obstruct your path to designing and building solutions.

You roll up your sleeves, try things out, and get things done. You do not hesitate to prototype, demo, and build in order to accelerate delivery of products for your end users.

You thrive in environments where you can collaborate with scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform complex scientific data into actionable outcomes. Your ability to engage with scientists and business leaders alike makes you a key player in maximizing the value of scientific data.

With rich experience applying cutting edge data methodologies to the biopharma R&D domain, you bridge understanding between present-day pain points and generalizable solutions.

You are an insatiable learner, with a track record of deeply learning new tools, methods, and domains.

You fundamentally embody the principles of extreme ownership and have a demonstrated history of building extensible data models and applications for Biopharma end users to maximize value from their data via analysis and integration with AI/ML.

This role will require extreme self-discipline and determination as we forge a category that will fundamentally and forever change the life science industry.

What You Have Done

  • PhD with +4 years or Masters with +8 years of industry experience in life sciences  with extensive domain knowledge in drug discovery (target ID through lead optimization), preclinical development, CMC (all drug modalities), or product quality testing.
  • Proven track record of defining, designing, prototyping, and implementing productized AI/ML-driven use cases in cloud environments
  • Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including product managers, software engineers, and scientific stakeholders.
  • Performed extensive exploratory data analysis and workflow optimization to enable scientific outcomes not previously possible.
  • Engaged diverse audiences, from scientists to executive stakeholders using your excellent communication and storytelling abilities.
  • Advised scientists in a consulting capacity to further research, development, and quality testing outcomes.

Requirements

What You Will Do

  • You will be a critical team member in a unique partnership to industrialize Scientific AI. As such, you will engage directly with customers onsite a couple of days per week in the Basel region, building strong relationships, deeply understanding their scientific data challenges and requirements, and accelerating solutions.
  • Design and implement extensible, reusable data models that efficiently capture and organize scientific data for scientific use cases, ensuring scalability and future adaptability.
  • Translate scientific data workflows into robust solutions leveraging the Tetra Data Platform.
  • Own, scope, prototype, and implement solutions including:
    • Data model design (tabular & JSON)
    • Python-based parser development.
    • Lab software (e.g., ELN/LIMS) integration via APIs.
    • Data visualization and app development in Python (using app frameworks like Streamlit and plotting tools like holoviews and Plotly) 
    • Collaborate with Scientific Business Analysts (SBAs), customer scientists and applied AI engineers to develop and deploy models (ML, AI, mechanistic, statistical, hybrid)
    • Programmatically interrogating proprietary instrument output files.
  • Dynamically iterate with scientific end users and technical stakeholders to rapidly drive solution development and adoption through regular demos and meetings
  • Proactively communicate implementation progress and deliver demos to customer stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the product team to build and prioritize our roadmap by understanding customers’ pain points within and outside Tetra Data Platform.
  • Rapidly learn new technologies (e.g., new AWS services or scientific analysis applications) to develop and troubleshoot use cases

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary and equity in a fast-growing company.
  • Supportive, team-oriented culture of continuous improvement.
  • Generous paid time off (PTO).
  • Flexible working arrangements - Remote work when not at Customer Sites

We are not currently providing visa sponsorship for this position.

title: Customer-Facing Software Engineer
original_description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

At Namespace, Customer-Facing Software Engineers work directly with customer engineering teams to solve complex infrastructure and developer workflow challenges. You'll serve as a technical partner and trusted advisor to customers, embedding within a wide variety of engineering organizations to understand how they build and ship software and help them improve, scale, and modernize those workflows. As an extension of our customers' engineering teams, you'll navigate complex systems, troubleshoot technical issues, and translate real-world challenges into product and platform improvements.

This is a highly technical, highly autonomous, and customer-facing role. You'll work across CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, developer tooling, build systems, and application environments, often requiring you to quickly understand unfamiliar technologies and workflows. Success depends on your ability to rapidly develop an understanding of complex systems, uncover high-leverage opportunities for improvement, and drive both tactical fixes and longer-term engineering outcomes. You'll work with a global customer base across the US, EU, Asia and Australia – primarily async via Slack and email, with on-site visits being the exception rather than the norm.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you’ll do

  • Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, infrastructure setups, operational and technical challenges

  • Quickly develop an understanding of new technical environments and independently drive issues and improvements opportunities from investigation through resolution

  • Reverse engineer customer systems and resolve issues spanning CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, developer tooling, build systems, and application environments

  • Act as an extension of our customers' engineering teams, helping them solve complex technical challenges and improve how they build and ship software

  • Build product improvements, tooling, integrations, and fixes that unblock customer teams, improve developer productivity, and streamline software delivery workflows

  • Identify recurring patterns across customer engagements and collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate them into platform improvements

  • Drive adoption through deep technical partnership, helping customers expand Namespace across additional workflows, teams, and infrastructure use cases

  • Develop deep expertise in modern developer workflows, infrastructure systems, and software delivery practices

What we’re looking for

  • Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to navigate unfamiliar systems quickly

  • Comfort debugging across modern infrastructure, developer tooling, and application environments

  • High curiosity and a systematic approach to problem-solving

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with technical teams and users

  • Bias toward execution and comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

  • Customer-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and urgency

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

title: Platform Deployment Engineer (Europe)
original_description:
Neural Concept embeds AI into design and simulation workflows so engineering teams make continuous, data-driven decisions instead of waiting on sequential design–simulation–validation cycles. None of that matters until the platform is running inside the customer's environment, on their infrastructure, under their rules.


That is this role. You take an enterprise customer and make the platform real for them: architected, deployed, integrated, cleared by their security organisation, and stable enough that their engineers stop thinking about it. You own that outcome end to end for named accounts, as their primary technical counterpart.

 

What you will do

  • The deployment, from the first architecture conversation through go-live and into steady-state operation.

  • Its integration with the customer's identity, data and engineering systems, and the infrastructure and model serving layer beneath it.

  • The relationship with their IT, security and platform teams: assessments, architecture reviews, and the call when something breaks.

  • The diagnosis when it does break, including when the cause sits outside our own software.

  • The runbooks, post-mortems and playbooks that make the next deployment easier, and the feedback loop into Product.

 

Where you will do it
Managed Kubernetes across the major clouds. On-premises and fully air-gapped clusters with no route to the internet, GPU infrastructure, self-hosted model serving. Customer HPC environments, schedulers, and shared storage under real load.

 

If installing software with no internet access, on hardware you do not control, reads as the interesting part of the job rather than the obstacle, this will suit you.

 

Who you are

You will often be the only Neural Concept engineer in the room. We are looking for someone with:

  • 6+ years deploying and operating enterprise software in production, two of them in environments you did not control.

  • Kubernetes at configuration depth: how chart values become rendered manifests, and why a workload will not start.

  • Identity and SSO fundamentals: OIDC and SAML, clients and credential rotation, redirect URIs, group-to-role mapping.

  • Linux, networking and TLS: DNS, routing, ingress and egress, certificate chains and interception proxies.

  • Kubernetes storage: persistent volumes and CSI, access modes, diagnosing shared storage that degrades under load.

  • A production deployment you personally carried and then supported. Name it, date it, tell us what went wrong.

  • Professional customer-facing English, and willingness to travel and work your customers' hours.

Also valuable: regulated or air-gapped deployments · private registries and image mirroring · GPU scheduling and LLM serving · enterprise IdP administration · Terraform and GitOps · Prometheus and Grafana · HPC schedulers · ISO 27001 evidence · Python · PLM, CAD or CAE exposure.

 

You Get

  • Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with remote work or hybrid model (20% remote) —we care about results, not rigid schedules.

 

Where You Will Be

  • Remote from Europe or one of our offices in Switzerland or Munich;

  • Travelling: This position will require travelling to customer location within Europe

  • Start date: ASAP

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer - Zero Trust
original_description:
About cogify group

cogify was founded in Switzerland in 2018 and today combines expertise in consulting, AI, software engineering, cybersecurity and digital products.

We are expanding our cybersecurity capabilities and are looking for a Cybersecurity Engineer with a strong interest in Zero Trust who understands how modern IT environments work and can turn security requirements into reliable technical solutions.

Your Mission

As a Cybersecurity Engineer, you work at the interface between security, infrastructure, cloud and delivery.

You understand how identities, devices, applications and networks interact, identify security weaknesses and implement controls that reduce risk without unnecessarily slowing down the business.

You work closely with our cybersecurity architects and engineering teams – from technical design and technology evaluation through configuration, integration, testing and production.

Requirements

Your Responsibilities

  • Implement and integrate Zero Trust security solutions
  • Configure and improve IAM, MFA, SSO, conditional access and least-privilege controls
  • Implement ZTNA, SASE, network segmentation and secure connectivity

title: Robotics Manufacturing Engineer
original_description:
The Robotics Manufacturing Engineer drives industrialization and manufacturing engineering for the Dexter surgical robot and its accessories by owning mechanical and mechatronic sustaining engineering, manufacturing testing, root-cause analysis of manufacturing issues, and design transfer. The role operates in a regulated ISO 13485 environment, with the CMO as the primary production site.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Act as the manufacturing link between the CMO, supply chain, quality and R&D (HQ), and support the commercial ramp-up of Dexter production.

• Perform level-2 production troubleshooting and mechanical root-cause analysis on complex electromechanical assemblies.

• Initiate and execute Change Requests, and associated Design Transfers, end-to-end in the regulated QMS, assess change impact on technical and quality aspects.

• Edit existing SolidWorks drawings, assemblies and BOMs to reflect manufacturing-level changes and submit rev-ups to R&D for review and approval.

• Contribute to pFMEA, DFM reviews, work instruction authorship and inspection plans; participate in IQ/OQ/PQ execution and reporting.

• Maintain manufacturing tools and test equipment and ensure they remain properly calibrated at the CMO site.

• Train CMO personnel on updated processes and documentation, and drive best practices and continuous improvement on the line.

• Ensure compliance with applicable norms and regulations, and maintain QMS documents and records — including Device History Records (DHR) capturing all Dexter robot configurations

Requirements

Work Experience and Education requirements:

• MSc or BSc with relevant experience in mechanical or mechatronics engineering.

• 3–6 years in medical device manufacturing (Class II).

• Hands-on experience with complex electromechanical assemblies in production.

• Working knowledge of ISO 13485 and demonstrated change-control execution experience.

• Strong plus: experience at a CMO / managing production at a sub-contractor site; surgical robotics, motion systems or implantable device background; design transfer ownership on a Class IIb or III device.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities required:

• Mechanical integration expertise: tolerance stack-up and interference assessment on complex assemblies without R&D escalation.

• SolidWorks at sustaining level: edit drawings, assemblies and BOMs; assess interferences, tolerances, fatigue and material/process constraints.

• Hands-on, floor-present approach; rigorous on documentation closure.

• Comfortable operating with indirect authority at a CMO site.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

• Open to travel, up to 60% (German-speaking Switzerland and broader Europe).

• Strong plus: French or German speaker.

Benefits

What we offer:

  • A dynamic, innovative environment with cutting-edge medical technology that is shaping the future of robotic surgery.
  • Fast-growing Company where innovation meets agility.
  • Structured onboarding program and training, ensuring a confident start.
  • High degree of autonomy and flexibility.

title: Junior Software Engineer - GTM Products
original_description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Responsibilities

  • Productionize prototypes. Take AI-built prototypes from the GTM team and make them real: authentication and access scoping, error handling, data integrity, tests, monitoring, documentation, handover.

  • Own the infrastructure. Hosting, environments, CI/CD, secrets, backups, dependencies and releases for every GTM-owned service.

  • Own security for partner-facing software. Authentication and role/hierarchy scoping, handling of partner and end-customer data, and answering the security questions partners and enterprise customers ask.

  • Own the code. Repositories, code review, feature flags, and the standard a prototype has to meet before it ships - including the authority to send one back.

  • Run rollouts. Staged releases, pilot partners, rollback plans, in cooperation with the GTM team communication that goes with a release.

  • Build an integrated solution landscape. The future is about data - this role works with our internal data, process and product specialists to build the integration system that allows to use the right data in the right way across all tools and departments

  • Context infrastructure. You co-own the context layer that is used for our GTM, sales, csm and other agents. 

  • Contribute to the AI engineering practice for Wingtra. Co-create the future of coding in a fast growing scaleup!


    • Requirements
  • A university degree in software engineering or computer science

  • Engineer who has operated software, not only built it. 3+ years full-stack; has run a customer-facing web application in production and been on the hook when it broke. TypeScript / Next.js, Postgres, a modern hosting platform.

  • AI-native. Coding agents are their default way of working, and they can review, harden and take ownership of code they did not write.

  • Security-literate practitioner. Authn/authz, multi-tenant scoping, secrets management, data-protection basics - enough to be the accountable owner without a security team behind them.

  • Integration-heavy background. CRM and ERP APIs (HubSpot, Odoo or equivalent), webhooks, and reconciling data across systems that disagree.

  • Product Management Experience. You can handle internal & external customer interactions and working with product management best practices

  • Holds a standard at a distance. Writes decisions down, communicates without being asked, and can send work back to people they rarely sit next to — including to this role’s own manager.


    • Plus

  • Commercial fluency. Reads a pricing model, a channel margin and a renewal term and understands why the business cares. Useful, not required - GTM brings the commercial framing, this role brings the engineering.

  • Experience in a partner or channel business, or with any two-tier distribution model

  • Has productionized other people’s prototypes before — an internal tools or platform team background

    • If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

title: Software Engineer, Simulation (Digital Twins)
original_description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill.

You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator.

What You'll Work On

  • Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials, sensors.

  • Training environments: RL environments for learned skills such as multi-robot patrol and search, randomised so nothing overfits one site.

  • Rare events: generate the scenarios real sites rarely produce: intrusions, sabotage, weather, sensor failures.

  • Sensor simulation: RGB, thermal and lidar realistic enough that what is learned in the twin holds on the robot.

  • Sim-to-real: measure the gap on real deployments and close it.

  • Scale: many parallel environments on GPUs, fast enough that a new skill trains in hours.

Who We're Looking For

A simulation engineer who treats the simulator as production infrastructure and measures success by what transfers to real robots.

Your Background

  • 3+ years building robotics simulation or RL training environments.

  • Hands-on with Isaac Sim or Isaac Lab; MuJoCo or Gazebo also considered.

  • Strong Python; C++ a plus.

  • 3D data: point clouds, meshes, scene formats such as USD.

  • GPU-parallel simulation and reinforcement learning workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Legged robots.

  • Photogrammetry, Gaussian splatting or other scene reconstruction.

  • ROS 2.

  • Thermal or lidar sensor modelling.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
original_description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation

title: Software Engineer Intern - Industrialization
original_description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.
 
We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.
 
This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.
 
 

The Opportunity

You will join the Industrialization team, the group that turns ANYmal from something engineers can build into something a factory can build, test, and release at volume. Every robot that leaves our production line passes through the test systems this team owns. When those tests are effective, quality issues are caught in Zurich before reaching a customer's industrial site. That is the leverage of this role.Sitting directly at the intersection of software and hardware, you will write Python code to interface with physical devices, help define reliable pass/fail criteria for ANYmal subsystems, and deploy test routines to our manufacturing shopfloor. Working alongside Manufacturing Engineers, test technicians, and hardware design teams, you will gain hands-on experience bridging cutting-edge robotics design with scalable industrial production.
 
 

The Market & Our Technology


ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Founded as an ETH Zurich spin-off, we build autonomous mobile robots (ANYmal) that solve complex inspection tasks in challenging industrial environments such as energy, chemical, and mining facilities. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people in Zurich and work on cutting-edge robot technology that is transforming industrial operations globally.

Your Impact
  • Develop, test, and help deploy Python-based automated test procedures for ANYmal hardware subsystems
  • Instrument and control hardware devices, sensors, and cameras directly through software interfaces
  • Collaborate with test technicians and manufacturing engineers to refine shopfloor testing workflows
  • Learn to write clean, resilient, and reproducible code using established software engineering best practices
  • Contribute directly to test documentation and technician procedures to ensure seamless shopfloor execution

    • Your Profile
  • Ongoing or recently completed degree (BSc or MSc) in Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering
  • Solid Python programming foundation with experience building projects that interact with hardware, sensors, or external APIs
  • Practical hands-on experience with hardware interfaces through university labs, student projects, or personal builds
  • Structured approach to problem-solving and a keen interest in measurement fundamentals like tolerances and repeatability
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfortable explaining technical concepts and drafting structured procedures
  • Proactive mindset with a desire to learn quickly, ask questions early, and work in a hands-on production environment
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Zurich, with a commitment to regular on-site presence near the hardware and shopfloor

    • Bonus Points
  • Experience with ROS or ROS2
  • Basic understanding of image processing or computer vision pipelines (OpenCV)
  • Exposure to sensor calibration techniques (IMU, camera intrinsics/extrinsics, depth, or thermal)
  • Familiarity with Docker or devcontainer environments
  • Background in student engineering teams such as Formula Student, Swissloop, or ARIS Rocketry, especially on testing or integration
    • Internship Details:
     
    Start date: any time of the year and always on the 1st of the month
    Duration: 6 months 
    Workload: 100% (Full time, Onsite)
     
    Who can apply:
    EU applicants for internships
    The internship can be voluntary
    A work permit is not required but the candidate needs a residence permit
    Must be enrolled in a University
     
    Non-EU applicants for internships:
    Internship must be mandatory (supported by a letter from a university)
    A work permit is required
    Must reside in CH
     
     
    Interested? Submit your application
    We will contact you if your skills and experience are a good fit for the team and the role. Please note due to the high load of applications we will only contact those that are relevant. Thank you for your understanding.
     
    What We Offer:
    - Hands-on experience working on advanced locomotion software.
    - Mentorship from industry experts.
    - Opportunities to contribute to innovative projects.
    - A dynamic and collaborative work environment.
    - Potential for future full-time opportunities.
     
    We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive and fun environment in the city of Zurich.

title: Systems Electrical Engineer (m/w/d) 80-100%
original_description:
Am Standort Schweiz entwickelt Signode innovative Umreifungsmaschinen und Verpackungslösungen für globale industrielle Anwendungen. Dabei werden Mechanik, Elektrotechnik, Softwareentwicklung und Systemtechnik miteinander verbunden.

Der Zweck dieser Position besteht in der Entwicklung moderner Systemkomponenten (Hard- und Software) innerhalb der Entwicklungsabteilung sowie deren Integration in bestehende Maschinen, Systemstrukturen und Steuerungssysteme. Die Rolle erfordert ein ganzheitliches Systemverständnis und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Konstruktion, Softwareentwicklung, Systems Engineering, Einkauf, Montage und Kundendienst.

Highlights:

  • Eine angenehme 40-Stunden-Woche

  • Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell

  • Ein kostenloser Parkplatz direkt vor der Tür

  • 100%-ige Übernahme der Unfall- und Krankentaggeldversicherungsprämien für Ihre Sicherheit

  • Ein Gehalt, das Ihr volles Engagement angemessen belohnt

  • Für den perfekten Energiekick: kostenloses Kaffeeangebot

  • Subventionierte Kantinenverpflegung: täglich frisch vor Ort zubereitetes Znüni- und Mittagessenangebot

  • Subventioniertes Massageangebot

  • Regelmässige Firmenanlässe

Zusammenhalt steht bei Signode an erster Stelle

Werden Sie Teil des globalen Teams und gestalten Sie Ihre Karriere in einem Umfeld, in dem nicht nur professionelle Erfolge, sondern auch persönliche Entfaltung zählt! Folgende zusätzliche Verantwortungen gestalten ebenfalls Ihren neuen Arbeitsalltag mit:

  • Entwicklung innovativer Systemkomponenten unter Berücksichtigung bestehender Automatisierungs-, Steuerungs- und Sicherheitskonzepte

  • Sicherstellung einer automatisierungsgerechten Systemarchitektur unter Berücksichtigung von Industrie-4.0- und vernetzten Maschinenkonzepten

  • Koordination elektrotechnischer Projekte hinsichtlich Termine, Kosten und Serienoptimierung

  • Analyse, Bewertung und Dokumentation von Automatisierungsprozessen sowie Erstellung von Pflichtenheften

  • Technische Führung und Koordination interner und externer Automatisierungs- und Engineering-Ressourcen

  • Entwicklung von SPS-Steuerungs- und Softwarearchitekturen (z. B. Siemens, Allen Bradley)

  • Projektleitung von elektrischen Entwicklungsprojekten in Hard- und Software (PCBAs, Antriebe, Benutzeroberflächen etc.)

  • Erstellung und Pflege normgerechter Schaltpläne und Stücklisten mit EPLAN

  • Ausarbeitung von Sicherheitskonzepten inklusive PL-Berechnungen nach EN ISO 13849

  • Integration von Komponenten in übergeordnete Automatisierungsumgebungen (Profinet, Ethernet/IP, Industrial Ethernet)

  • Durchführung von Funktions-, Software-, Sicherheits- und Kommunikationstests an Prototypen

  • Unterstützung der Serienproduktion bei Optimierung, Parametrierung und Fehlerbehebung

  • Inbetriebnahme, Parametrierung, Optimierung und Abnahme von Systemkomponenten einschliesslich Fehleranalyse, Upgrades und technischem Kundensupport

  • Mitwirkung bei globalen Rollout- und Integrationsprojekten (EPLAN, Siemens S7 / TIA Portal, Allen Bradley)


Bringen Sie zudem folgende Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten mit, sind vielleicht genau Sie das passende Teammitglied:

  • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung auf FH- oder HF-Niveau in Automatisierungs- oder Systemtechnik mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der industriellen Automatisierungs- und Steuerungstechnik

  • Branchenkenntnisse in der industriellen Elektrotechnik, zu gängigen Herstellern sowie relevanten IEC-, ISO- und EN-Normen

  • Kenntnisse in der Antriebstechnik

  • Gute SPS-Programmierkenntnisse (Siemens S7 / TIA Portal, Allen Bradley)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit EPLAN (EN 60204-1)

  • Vertiefte Normenkenntnisse (Maschinenrichtlinie 2006/42/EG, EN ISO 13849, EN 60204-1 resp. Maschinenverordnung 2023/1230)

  • Erfahrung mit PL-Berechnungen und Risikobeurteilungen

  • Kenntnisse industrieller Kommunikationssysteme (Profinet, Ethernet/IP)

  • Erfahrung in Inbetriebnahme und technischem Kundensupport

  • Kenntnisse in Elektronik und Mikroprozessorprogrammierung (μP)
