title: Machine Learning Certification Researcher
original_description:
About the Role

Imagine pioneering the mathematical and logical foundations that enable AI to fly safely in real-world, safety-critical aviation. As a Machine Learning Certification Researcher, you will address one of the most fundamental challenges in modern AI: proving that ML models are safe, reliable, and mathematically sound for deployment in autonomous flight. Your work will bridge the gap between cutting-edge statistical learning theory and formal aviation certification frameworks, building upon previous work (EASA CoDANN I and II, and FAA report DOT/FAA/TC-21/48), and putting real-world systems to the test.

At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in mission-critical operations worldwide. Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision—developing safety-critical AI systems at the intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. Enabling machines to perceive, understand, and make decisions in real time, we combine aerospace engineering and artificial intelligence to build the next generation of autonomous flight systems, driving innovation where it matters most.

What You'll Do

• AI Certification Strategy: Analyze our existing AI certification strategy and help adapt it—or pioneer entirely new strategies—to certify different supervised ML.

• EASA Framework Alignment: Connect mathematical guarantees, technical arguments, and model evaluations to the EASA W-shaped process for AI certification in aviation, ensuring our research aligns with the latest regulatory guidelines.

• Theoretical Foundation & Modeling: Conduct research into statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and mathematical guarantees for deep neural networks operating under dynamic real-world conditions.

• Uncertainty Quantification: Apply statistics and stochastic processes to model environmental uncertainties and sensor noise, and to quantify confidence in performance metrics.

• Literature & Proof Evaluation: Critically evaluate academic literature, mathematical proofs, and engineering assumptions with peer-review rigor to identify safety limitations and theoretical gaps in state-of-the-art AI.

• Regulatory & Audit Justification: Construct robust, logical arguments and technical justifications that translate complex, high-dimensional empirical data into structured evidence for safety audits and certification frameworks.

• Algorithmic Validation: Write clean, reproducible code in Python to test theoretical hypotheses, validate certification mechanisms, and benchmark model safety frameworks.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Machine Learning Theory & Mathematics

• ML Theory & Statistical Learning: Deep understanding of statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and the mathematical foundations of deep neural networks.

• Statistics & Stochastic Processes: Strong background in advanced probability, statistical modeling, and stochastic processes.

• Python Engineering: Proficiency in Python with the ability to write clean, reproducible code (can also be learned on the job provided strong theoretical foundations and basic Python coding).

Research Rigor

• Scientific Research Methodology: Demonstrated capability or background in conducting comprehensive literature reviews, identifying gaps in current state-ofthe-art AI, and synthesizing complex academic concepts into actionable engineering frameworks (can also be learned on the job if you possess a strong quantitative baseline).

• Peer Review Expertise: Ability or experience in the peer-review process—capable of critically evaluating mathematical proofs, algorithmic assumptions, and research papers to assess their validity and limitations.

Education

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Theoretical Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related quantitative research field.

Who You Are

• Critical Thinking & Healthy Skepticism: You possess a strong spirit of questioning everything. You naturally challenge conventional ML assumptions, probe for hidden edge cases, and refuse to take empirical accuracy at face value without rigorous proof.

• Logical Argument Building: You have an exceptional ability to construct robust, airtight logical arguments and technical justifications. You can translate complex empirical observations into structured, defensible evidence that satisfies strict

engineering and regulatory scrutiny.

• Thrives in Ambiguity: You are motivated by hard, unsolved mathematical problems at the intersection of theoretical computer science, safety engineering, and real-world flight operations

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
original_description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Mechanical Design Engineer to join our engineering team in Lausanne. In this role, you will lead the physical product design of hardware assemblies, mechanical housings, custom structures, and precision mechanisms, guiding products through CAD design, drafting, prototype verification, and industrialisation.

From day one, you will own the transition of concepts into production-ready physical hardware. You will maintain strict product data management standards, apply geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, run thermal and stress analyses, work with suppliers across various manufacturing processes, and perform hands-on prototype assembly and testing.

What You Will Do

  • CAD Design & Drafting: Create clean, fully constrained CAD models, multi-part assembly layouts, and detailed engineering drawings following formal geometric dimensioning and tolerancing standards.

  • Product Data & Configuration Management: Manage engineering change requests, update bill of materials data, maintain material libraries, and enforce configuration controls in digital product data systems.

  • Prototype Assembly & Verification: Build physical prototypes, test assembly sequences, verify fit and tolerance stack-ups, and establish unit build procedures.

  • Environmental & Stress Analysis: Perform structural, thermal, vibration, and mechanical shock simulations to ensure hardware survives harsh operational environments.

  • Manufacturing & Supplier Integration: Work closely with suppliers to optimize designs for production methods such as CNC machining, stamping, pressing, forging, casting, and injection molding.

  • Cross-Functional Interface Management: Collaborate with electronics, simulation, testing, and systems engineering teams to define physical interface control documents, packaging requirements, and technical datasheets.

What We Are Looking For

  • Background: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

  • CAD & Drafting Experience: Strong proficiency in production CAD environments with experience applying formal drafting standards such as ASME or ISO GD&T.

  • Product Data Management: Practical experience with configuration management practices, engineering change notices, and product data systems such as Siemens Teamcenter or similar PDM/PLM tools.

  • Manufacturing Tooling & Processes: Design experience across multiple manufacturing methods including machining, stamping, casting, forging, and molding.

  • Analysis & Verification: Ability to perform basic environmental, thermal, shock, and stress evaluations to qualify hardware designs against operational requirements.

  • Proactive Execution: Practical mindset with strong hands-on skills for prototype assembly, vendor management, and technical troubleshooting.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to establish core mechanical design capability and elevate drafting standards within a growing engineering team.

  • Direct hands-on work spanning initial CAD concepts through to manufacturing and field testing.

  • Broad exposure to complex electromechanical hardware, structural housings, and safety-critical mechanisms.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Design & Simulation Engineer
original_description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our engineering team in Lausanne. You will handle the end-to-end design, numerical simulation, and physical validation of specialised mechanical and electromechanical structures to optimize system performance and match hardware capabilities to demanding operational requirements.

From day one, you will take ownership of mechanical architectures and physical assemblies. You will run non-linear explicit finite element simulations, build high-precision CAD models, set up lab and range tests, and see designs through to production and final delivery.

What You Will Do

  • Structural & Dynamics Simulation: Run non-linear explicit finite element simulations to build predictive models for structural integrity, dynamic impact, vibration response, and high-velocity mechanical behavior against extreme physical operational environments.

  • CAD Design & Drafting: Create and maintain complex CAD models, structural housings, mechanisms, and technical drawings for production release.

  • Empirical Testing & Data Capture: Write R&D test specifications for environmental, drop, structural, and shock testing. Source specialized testing equipment, manage range and lab setups, and analyze sensor data to validate simulation accuracy.

  • Cross-Functional Integration: Work directly with multidisciplinary engineering teams to advise on physical constraints, payload optimization, spatial layouts, and mechanical integration parameters.

  • Safety & Hazard Assessments: Conduct system-level hazard analyses and safety evaluations for critical mechanical mechanisms and energetic system interfaces.

  • Production & Field Support: Document hardware performance guidelines, assist with first-production validation, optimize designs for manufacturing processes, and provide technical support during end-user demos and customer engagements.

What We Are Looking For

  • Background: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related technical discipline.

  • Simulation Expertise: Hands-on experience with non-linear explicit finite element analysis applied to high-velocity mechanical impact, dynamic loading, shock waves, and material failure models.

  • Mechanical Systems Knowledge: Deep understanding of mechanical hardware, structural mechanics, tolerance stack-ups, thermal dissipation, and dynamic load transfer.

  • R&D Range & Lab Testing: Practical experience setting up, executing, and analyzing data from physical prototype testing, environmental chambers, dynamic test tracks, or field evaluation programs.

  • CAD & Manufacturing: Solid proficiency in standard CAD software for complex assembly design, mechanical drafting, and manufacturing processes like CNC machining, additive manufacturing, or injection molding.

  • Drive & Ownership: Practical problem-solver who takes full responsibility for hardware deliverables and balances physical analysis with project timelines.

What We Offer

  • Direct exposure to high-performance mechanical design from early concepts through physical deployment.

  • Regular opportunities to test and validate hardware in realistic operational test environments.

  • Involvement with cross-functional technical teams and external stakeholders deploying mission-critical systems.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Robotics Integration Engineer
original_description:
About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role You Will

  • Design, integrate and test the electromechanical systems at the core of our dexterous robots: actuator modules, joints, and end-effectors, sensors, PCBs, and cable harnesses into compact, reliable units for high-DoF robotics

  • Bring hardware to life: lead system assembly & bring-up, debug across mechanics, electronics, and firmware, and work with controls & AI engineers to build a fully vertically integrated manipulation system

  • Develop & build automated test setups to validate performance, durability, and reliability, and take systems from prototype to series production

What We're Looking For

  • Degree (BSc/MSc/PhD) in mechatronics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field

  • 3+ years of work experience developing complex mechatronic systems that bridge mechanical design, electronics, and software

  • Solid understanding of electric motors, encoders, sensors, and motor drivers, and how to integrate them into a working system

  • Experience with system-level debugging and testing using tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, and data acquisition systems

  • Comfortable with programming for test automation and data analysis (e.g., Python)

  • Familiarity designing parts in CAD (e.g. Onshape)

  • Hands-on experience with rapid prototyping, workshop tools, soldering, 3D printing, and prototype assembly/testing

  • Fluency in English (spoken and written), with strong interpersonal and communication skills

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Hands-on development experience with high-DoF robotic systems (e.g., robotic arms, end-effectors, dexterous hands, or humanoids)

  • Development experience with actuator systems (frameless motors, gearboxes, encoders, and integrated drives)

  • Experience with motor control and communication buses such as EtherCAT or CAN

  • Experience with PCB design or schematic review, and cable harness design

  • Thermal management for compact, high-power electronics and actuators

What we offer

  • The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time

  • A fast-paced learning environment alongside an outstanding, driven team

  • Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup

  • Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • A world-class in-person setup in central Zürich, with excellent prototyping, robotics, and technical infrastructure for hands-on builders

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity participation

title: Mechanical Engineer
original_description:
About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role You Will

  • Design the mechanical center piece of our dexterous manipulation systems: structural components, joints, linkages, transmissions, end-effectors, and housings, with tight trade-offs between weight, stiffness, precision, and cost

  • Own your designs end-to-end: from early concepts and mechanical architecture to series production: build and test prototypes in days, back them up with FEM, tolerance stack-ups, fatigue analysis, and lab testing until they’re production-ready

  • Work closely with manufacturing partners: turn prototypes into reliable, manufacturable, cost-effective parts

  • Build a fully vertically integrated robot: work hand in hand with electronics, controls, and AI teams to push what robotic manipulation can do

What We’re Looking For

  • Degree (BSc/MSc/PhD) in mechanical engineering or a related field

  • 3+ years of work experience designing and developing complex mechanical systems

  • Excellent CAD skills (e.g., Onshape) and experience with PDM and release workflows

  • Solid experience with structural analysis (FEM) and tolerance analysis

  • Deep understanding of design for manufacturing/assembly/cost

  • Strong knowledge of manufacturing methods, including CNC machining, sheet metal, 3D printing, injection molding and other tooled parts, and precision assemblies

  • Hands-on experience with rapid prototyping (3D printing, laser cutting), workshop tools, and prototype assembly/testing

  • Fluency in English (spoken and written), with strong interpersonal and communication skills

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Hands-on development experience with high-DoF robotic systems (e.g., robotic arms, end-effectors, dexterous hands, or humanoids)

  • Actuator and drivetrain design (frameless motors, gearboxes such as harmonic, cycloidal, or planetary, and housings)

  • Thermal management and cooling design for compact, high-power assemblies

  • Experience mechanically integrating sensors, PCBs, and cable harnesses into moving systems

What we offer

  • The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time

  • A fast-paced learning environment alongside an outstanding, driven team

  • Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup

  • Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • A world-class in-person setup in central Zürich, with excellent prototyping, robotics, and technical infrastructure for hands-on builders

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity participation

title: Young Graduate in Data and Software Engineering (Zurich, Switzerland)
original_description:
Who We Are

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organizations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 300 projects and have grown to 190+ talented individuals across 10 office locations.


Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

Unit8 is welcoming young graduates for the opportunity to grow in Data and Software Engineering! Join us for a 6-month paid professional experience in building industrial Data and AI solutions. You can start asap, with direct exposure to clients' needs and opportunities to participate in learning activities such as Reading Groups and Knowledge Sharing Sessions. In addition, each young graduate will be accompanied by a dedicated wingmate/mentor who will guide and help them build their technical growth vision.


As a young graduate you will join a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Cloud Engineers who work hand-in-hand with our customers on designing and implementing their industry-specific use cases. You will be directly involved in discussing the client’s challenges and needs and will have chances to develop your client-facing skills. You will be responsible for developing, deploying, and automating our AI services and cloud infrastructure. You will also learn to carefully analyse a given problem and apply the relevant tools and techniques to solve it.

In general you will:

  • use software best practices in continuous integration and delivery, versioning and automation;
  • use your skills to build and maintain service and data infrastructure;
  • participate as junior engineer in all phases of the software development life cycle - planning, implementation, deployment, testing and maintenance;

Are You the team member we are looking for?

In order to be successful in this role, you are/have:

  • motivated and eager to learn different aspects of engineering
  • comfortable interacting with technical and business people
  • strong communication and presentation skills
  • recently graduated/finishing your MSc or BSc in Computer Science or related major;
  • familiar with version control and collaboration tooling (git)
  • familiar with CI/CD frameworks and automated deployment concepts (i.e Docker, K8s)
  • fluent in both English and German
  • available for a minimum of 32h a week.
  • ready to start on the 1st of February

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Each client is different and provides unique opportunities to learn.
  • Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts (https://github.com/unit8co/darts)
  • Learning activities such as ML Reading Group, knowledge sharing sessions with engineers.
  • Training-on-the-job and your personal wingmate/mentor
  • 15 paid days of holiday
  • Be part of an international team of more than 20 nationalities.
  • up to 10% of paid time for self-development.
  • Flexible working hours, including some home office.
  • Cross offices/company-wide frequent events like offsites.
  • If you are successful, opportunity to be then hired for a permanent position.

title: Software Engineer (Java)
original_description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


Position description

We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join the CI Experience squad within our Code Orchestration department.

The CI Experience squad enables users to analyze their projects in their own CI, making analysis a core part of their workflow. We have a mission to make analysis reliable, fast, configurable and developer-friendly.

 

What you will do

  • Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and engineers to build the best CI-based analysis experience.

  • Contribute well tested and production ready code.

  • Participate in the on-call operation of analysis infrastructure, including feature deployments, production monitoring, incident response, and troubleshooting.

  • Contribute to the definition of the team’s short and long-term goals.


    • Experience and qualifications
  • MS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience).

  • 0-3 years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Proficiency with Java.

  • Solid engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and the ability to reason about correctness and performance

    •  

    Nice to have

  • Familiarity with a variety of build systems and CI runners.

    • In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

title: Electrical Engineer
original_description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Electrical Engineer, you will own that hardware end to end, from sensor choice and PCB to firmware, so that the data reaching our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and integrate the hardware that captures the data our models learn from: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

  • Own the firmware and embedded-software layer: real-time data collection, multi-sensor sync, calibration, and time-stamping.

  • Spec and select sensors and compute for new hardware projects, balancing physical constraints against downstream ML needs.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your hardware delivers their training data, and bad sensor choices haunt them for months.

  • Prototype fast: bench builds, custom rigs, breadboard to working device in days, not quarters.

Requirements

  • Up to 5 years building production-grade hardware or IoT systems.

  • Strong embedded-software skills: C/C++, RTOS, and microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

  • Experience integrating sensors: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

  • A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: electrode placement, sample rate, filtering, noise floor, and motion artifacts. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly.

  • Comfortable with PCB design and hardware debugging (logic analyzer, oscilloscope), with at least one foot in firmware.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be".

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

  • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

  • Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

  • Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

  • Open-source firmware or hardware contributions.

  • Experience scaling from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, vendor management, and certification.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

title: Embedded Control Engineer
original_description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will play a key part in developing the embedded control platform and will translate functional and control requirements into embedded hardware and software architectures, select appropriate microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA, or other controller technologies, and develop real-time software close to the hardware implementation. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, safety, and will require close collaboration with power electronics, integrated electronics, mechanical, thermal, and system engineers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define embedded controller architectures for power electronic converters and select suitable microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA.

  • Translate power electronics and control requirements into efficient, deterministic, and robust real-time software implementations.

  • Develop, test, debug, and validate embedded software on target hardware, from individual software blocks through complete controller implementations and automated testing environments to validate the design.

  • Explore new controller technologies, embedded architectures, and software implementation concepts to improve converter performance, flexibility, reliability, functionality, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • You have a strong understanding of embedded architectures, and the practical considerations involved in selecting controllers for demanding real-time applications.

  • You are an expert in embedded software development for real-time applications, preferably in power electronics, industrial automation, or similar applications, spanning FPGA programming, systems programming, hardware interfaces and communication protocols.

  • You are experienced in monitoring and debugging software directly on target hardware

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with model-based development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated testing, or safety-critical software development is a plus.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Data Scientist
original_description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world's leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is at our core and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is looking for a mid-level Data Scientist to build recommendation systems that improve how travelers discover and choose travel options.

You’ll translate product and business questions into measurable modeling problems, develop and test solutions with data and experimentation, and partner with researchers, engineers, and cross-functional teams to bring promising work into production. Your work will improve the traveler experience and key business metrics across KAYAK.

If you’re excited to solve challenging recommendation problems and make a measurable difference for travelers, we’d love to hear from you.

This role will be required to work from our Zurich office 3 days per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Translate product and business challenges into well-defined modeling problems, hypotheses, and measurable objectives.

  • Ship production-ready, scalable Machine Learning solutions with real-world impact on user experience and key business metrics.

  • Design and evaluate experiments, building rapid prototypes, assessing results rigorously, and iterating on promising ideas.

  • Collaborate across Data Science, Product, and Engineering, communicating findings, recommendations, and trade-offs clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Please apply if you have:

  • Strong technical foundations in statistics, machine learning, and programming, backed by a track record of solving complex, real-world data science problems. Demonstrated capability matters more than academic credentials.

  • Hands-on experience developing ML models in business or production environments, with the ability to clearly explain the problems addressed, your specific contributions, and the resulting impact.

  • Ownership, sound judgment, and analytical thinking, with the ability to navigate technical trade-offs, work independently, and recognize when to seek guidance.

  • Fluency with AI-assisted workflows, leveraging modern tools to improve productivity and quality while critically evaluating their outputs and limitations.

  • Curiosity, humility, and a collaborative mindset, with a commitment to continuous learning, sharing knowledge, and improving together.

Bonus qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with technologies relevant to KAYAK’s stack, such as PyTorch, Polars, CometML, Arize, Docker, Airflow, Trino and Git/Github.

  • Familiarity with Agile ways of working, such as sprint planning and team ceremonies.

Benefits & Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 5 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Social events & Thursday happy hours

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Supplemental accident insurance

  • Health insurance subsidy of 250 CHF per month

  • Lunch Check Card of 180 CHF per month

  • Profawo membership which is a non-profit organization dedicated to promoting the compatibility of family and work

 

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

title: DevOps Engineer
original_description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

As a DevOps Engineer at Namespace, you'll build and operate the infrastructure that makes this performance possible. You'll own the compute, storage, and networking behind every build our customers run, keeping the platform fast, reliable, and cost-effective as we accelerate more companies around the world.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of the infrastructure that runs every customer’s build, test, and CI job on Namespace.

  • Optimize performance across compute, memory, storage, and networking.

  • Automate provisioning, deployment, scaling, and recovery across our fleet.

  • Build observability, alerting, and incident response processes that identify and resolve issues before they affect customers.

  • Drive capacity planning and cost efficiency, so we continue to deliver infrastructure that is both faster and more cost-effective.

  • Collaborate closely with product engineers to ship new capabilities quickly and safely.

What we're looking for

  • Strong engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience operating production infrastructure at scale.

  • Deep knowledge of Linux, networking, and storage, plus experience with tools like Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar.

  • Proficiency in Go, Python, or a similar language, automation is paramount.

  • Deep experience with observability tooling and participating in on-call rotations.

  • A strong focus on performance and a rigorous approach to measuring and improving it.

  • Bonus: experience with bare metal, virtualization (KVM, Firecracker), or running CI/CD systems at scale.

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

title: Power Electronics Engineer
original_description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

Join our team to work on cutting-edge power conversion technologies, developing solutions that combine high power density, high voltage and current, fast dynamic response, and demanding efficiency and reliability requirements. In this role, you will translate functional and system requirements into robust power-stage solutions. Your work will contribute to optimizing efficiency, thermal performance, reliability, scalability, and power density. You will work closely with colleagues across integrated electronics, embedded software, mechanical, thermal, and system engineering.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Evaluate and develop power conversion topologies for converters, considering performance, efficiency, electrical stresses, thermal behaviour, reliability, power density, and system requirements.

  • Design and develop magnetic components such as inductors, transformers, and chokes, including selection of magnetic materials, core geometries, winding concepts, and evaluation of losses and thermal limitations.

  • Develop analytical and simulation models to evaluate converter behaviour, semiconductor stresses, switching and conduction losses, efficiency, and performance across relevant operating conditions.

  • Build prototypes and perform laboratory testing, characterization, verification, troubleshooting, and validation of power electronic circuits and converter stages.

  • Analyse test results and correlate measurements with simulations and calculations to identify design improvements and validate converter performance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.

  • You are experienced in taking power-stage designs from initial concept and simulation through component selection, prototype implementation, laboratory measurement, debugging, and validation.

  • You are an expert in power conversion topologies, power semiconductors, magnetic components, and passive components.

  • Experience with electro-thermal simulation tools such as PLECS is a plus.

  • Experience with SiC or GaN semiconductors, high-frequency magnetics is a plus.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Embedded Engineer
original_description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy.

What You Will Do

  • Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

  • Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample.

  • Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

  • Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast.

  • Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data.

  • Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong.

Requirements

  • Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems.

  • Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar.

  • Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

  • A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly.

  • Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be".

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

  • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

  • Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design.

  • Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

  • Open-source firmware contributions.

  • Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

title: Design Release Engineer -Airframe
original_description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Design Release Manager to join our Airframe Team in Lausanne. In this role, you will bridge the gap between initial mechanical concept and full-scale manufacturing, taking complete ownership of the manufacturing dossier for our composite structures and airframe modules.

From day one, you will drive Design for Manufacturability and Design for Assembly directly inside the design loop, before parts are frozen. You will set and hold the release standard, define geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, manage engineering change orders, and act as the single authority signing off on product transfer gates to manufacturing.

What You Will Do

  • Manufacturing Dossier Ownership: Own and maintain the complete transfer package for your designated airframe module, including controlled drawing packages, bill of materials structures, material and finish specifications, critical characteristics, and acceptance criteria.

  • Design Loop Integration: Collaborate directly with mechanical design engineers early in the design phase to optimize composite layups, bonded joints, tooling interfaces, and tolerance stack-ups while design changes are still fast and low cost.

  • Transfer Gate & Release Authority: Serve as the final authority on product release packages, evaluating transfer readiness against gate standards before handing hardware over to manufacturing operations.

  • Disposition & Configuration Management: Manage engineering change orders and serve as the single technical contact for drawing dispositions, non-conformance reviews, and design clarification requests from the production line.

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Alignment: Work closely with production operations and external suppliers to evaluate manufacturing constraints for composite structures and precision assemblies.

  • Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Analyze initial production build data and floor feedback to refine manufacturing dossiers and update gate standards for future design iterations.

What We Are Looking For

  • Background: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline.

  • Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerance Analysis: Practical mastery of applying GD&T with intent, performing tolerance stack-up analyses, and defining clear acceptance criteria.

  • Composite Structures & Manufacturing: Strong working knowledge of composite materials, layup sequences, tooling limitations, cure cycles, and bonded structural joints.

  • Drawing & Package Control: Proven experience owning released drawing packages, managing structured bill of materials, and running engineering change order workflows.

  • Early Stage Execution: Demonstrated success integrating manufacturing and assembly principles directly into active design reviews rather than conducting post-design audits.

  • Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and French to work fluidly across design engineering and French-speaking production teams.

What We Offer

  • Direct ownership in defining the release and manufacturing transfer standards for high-performance defense airframes.

  • Active collaboration with design engineers early in the development cycle where engineering decisions carry high leverage.

  • High-visibility technical impact across fast-scaling, hardware-centric production programs.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Senior SAP Analytics Architekt BDC – Aufbau Business Data Cloud, mit Potential
original_description:
Über das Unternehmen

Ein etabliertes Schweizer Unternehmen stellt seine Analytics-Landschaft neu auf und setzt dabei konsequent auf SAP Business Data Cloud. Gesucht wird eine Persönlichkeit, die diesen Aufbau nicht begleitet, sondern selbst gestaltet.

Über die Rolle

Hier geht es nicht um das Verwalten einer bestehenden BW-Landschaft. Im Vordergrund stehen Projekte mit SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC), die zu den aktuellsten im Schweizer SAP-Markt gehören. Sie bringen Architektur-Know-how und Pioniergeist mit, treiben die Einführung von BDC hands-on voran und verbinden sie sinnvoll mit SAP BW und SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC). Wer Lust hat, etwas von Grund auf mitzugestalten, findet hier eine seltene Gelegenheit - Mit Potenzial thematische/disziplinarische Verantwortung.

Aufgaben

  • Aufbau und Architektur der SAP Business Data Cloud, von der Zielarchitektur bis zu den ersten produktiven Use Cases

  • Hands-on-Umsetzung von BDC-Projekten und Integration mit der bestehenden BW- und SAC-Landschaft

  • Projektleitung für Planungs- und Reporting-Lösungen, von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zum Go-Live

  • Mitgestaltung der Analytics-Strategie: Sie setzen Standards, die über Jahre Bestand haben

  • Fachliche Ansprechperson und Sparringspartner im Analytics-Team sowie Schnittstelle zu Fachbereichen, Stakeholdern und externen Partnern

  • Bei Interesse: Übernahme der fachlichen Führung oder Teamleitung (8 Mitarbeitende), inklusive Ressourcenplanung und Staffing

Qualifikationen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Architekt oder Projektleiter im SAP-Analytics-Umfeld (BW, SAC)

  • Erste Erfahrung mit SAP BDC, SAP Datasphere oder vergleichbaren Cloud-Data-Plattformen, oder zumindest echte Neugier, sich hier tief einzuarbeiten

  • Freude daran, Neues aufzubauen statt Bestehendes zu verwalten

  • Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Planungsprozesse und Reporting-Anforderungen

  • Kommunikationsstärke im Umgang mit Fachbereichen und Management

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im SAP-Analytics-Umfeld (BW, SAC)

  • Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Planungsprozesse und Reporting-Anforderungen

  • Kommunikationsstärke im Umgang mit Fachbereichen und Management

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Bevorzugte Fähigkeiten

  • Projekterfahrung mit SAP Business Data Cloud oder SAP Datasphere

  • Erste Führungserfahrung oder Interesse, mittelfristig Teamverantwortung zu übernehmen

Vergütung und Leistungspaket

Das erwartet Sie:

  • Cutting-Edge-Projekte: BDC-Erfahrung, wie sie im Markt noch kaum jemand hat

  • Echter Aufbau-Spielraum: Sie prägen Architektur und Analytics-Strategie von Beginn an

  • Entwicklungsperspektive nach Ihrer Wahl: Senior-Fachkarriere oder Weg in die Fach- bzw. Teamleitung

  • Überdurchschnittliche Anstellungsbedingungen mit attraktivem Gehaltspaket

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice

  • Langfristige Perspektive in einem zukunftssicheren, wachsenden Umfeld

So läuft es ab

  • Ihre Bewerbung landet direkt bei uns, diskret, schnell und ohne Umwege. Wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

  • In einem ersten vertraulichen Gespräch schauen wir gemeinsam auf Ihren SAP-Schwerpunkt, Ihre Erfahrung mit BDC oder Datasphere und darauf, ob Sie sich eher in der Fachrolle oder perspektivisch in der Führung sehen.

  • Anschliessend begleiten wir Sie persönlich durch den weiteren Bewerbungsprozess.

Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

title: Software Architect (Java / Spring Boot & Microservices)
original_description:
About Joyful Craftsmen AG

For over 10 years, Joyful Craftsmen has been a trusted partner globally, empowering organizations to unlock the full potential of their data. Primarily serving clients across Europe while collaborating with companies worldwide through remote solutions, we help businesses turn data into a strategic asset through tailored delivery in areas such as Data and AI Strategy.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced Software Architect at Senior or Expert level to support a long-term strategic modernization program in a complex enterprise environment. The project focuses on further developing the target architecture and migrating existing Java EE applications and monolithic systems to a modern, Spring Boot-based microservices architecture.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze and model business requirements in collaboration with business departments, product teams, and other stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain target, transition, and solution architectures for the modernization of existing Java EE applications.

  • Design migration strategies and deployment concepts for transitioning legacy applications to a modern Spring Boot and microservices landscape.

  • Develop architectural concepts covering application design, enterprise integration, interfaces, data models, data storage, and security.

  • Create solution designs, technical concepts, and prototypes to support implementation and architectural decision-making.

  • Advise development teams and stakeholders on architectural decisions, technology choices, and implementation approaches.

title: Working Student Software Engineering
original_description:
Intro

For this position we are looking for students or recent graduates in Zürich, working hybrid at the ETH Student Project House (SPH) and remotely.

Nairon GmbH is a Swiss startup building AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls for businesses. Our platform runs real-time conversations over the phone and on the web, connected to our customers' telephony and business tools. We value clear communication, thoughtful engineering, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving. Join us as we continue to develop tools that make a difference.

We are looking for a Working Student (30–60%) who wants to work on real production systems next to their studies. We are flexible on the duration of the employment.

Tasks

As a Working Student at Nairon GmbH, you will work with our team on one or more of these areas, depending on your interests and skills:

  • Voice AI: turn-taking, latency measurements, LLM prompting and tool calls, and evaluating speech models (STT and TTS).

  • Voice model training: training foundational speech models (TTS and STT) on GPUs: data collection and preparation, training runs, fine-tuning for German and Swiss-German voices, and evaluation.

  • Realtime backend: Python services around our LiveKit-based media platform, messaging and integrations with customer systems.

  • Web and mobile: features in our Next.js / React / TypeScript web application and our Expo / React Native app.

  • Platform: Docker, Kubernetes, monitoring and the tooling that keeps our services running.

  • Commercial and tech sales: preparing demos and pilot agents, answering customers' technical questions, market and competitor research, and supporting offers and partner conversations.

  • Building test calls, benchmarks and small internal tools, and writing down what you learn.

Requirements

Experience:

Currently enrolled at ETH Zürich or another university or Fachhochschule, or graduated recently, in computer science, electrical engineering, data science, business and engineering (e.g. MTEC, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen) or a related field. First project or work experience is a plus, not a must.

Technical Skills:

Required:

  • Programming in Python or TypeScript; for the engineering areas, good fundamentals in Git, APIs and debugging.

  • For commercial work: a solid technical understanding and the ability to explain technology to customers.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with LLMs, speech or audio processing, or machine learning.

  • Deep learning with PyTorch, training on GPUs, or a related thesis or research project.

  • Next.js, React or mobile development.

  • Docker, Linux or cloud platforms.

  • Interest in sales, business development or startups.

Communication:

English proficiency is essential, both written and spoken, as it is the working language for all positions.

German is a plus, and important for customer-facing work.

Soft Skills:

  • Curious, quick to learn and able to work independently.

  • Reliable with the hours you commit to, next to your studies.

Benefits

  • Flexible Work Setup: Hybrid: work at the ETH Student Project House in Zürich and remotely, around your study schedule.

  • Equipment Provided: Company laptop provided.

  • Collaborative Environment: Join a small, agile team where your contributions go into production.

  • Growth Opportunities: Real experience in AI voice technology and in building a startup, with the possibility of a thesis topic or a full-time role in engineering or sales after your studies.

Closing

If you want to build AI that talks on real phone lines while you study, we'd love to hear from you. Please tell us which areas interest you most, technical or commercial, and how many hours per week you can work.

title: Team Lead Infrastructure (Volunteer) - Startup Nights 2027
original_description:
Start as soon as possible so you can join the current team at Startup Nights 2026 and take over with live context. Startup Nights is the Swiss Startup Association's flagship festival and one of Switzerland's largest startup and innovation events, bringing around 10,000 visitors, 1,000+ founders and 200 exhibiting startups together. For 7-8 October 2027 we move to Zurich, and we are looking for a hands-on volunteer leader to make sure the event stands, runs and holds.

Tasks

  • Lead the infrastructure team across stage and power, welcome area, decor and signage, hall layout, setup, permits and security, logistics, and waste management.
  • Own the end-to-end plan for setup and teardown, deliveries, materials, signage, access and visitor flows.
  • Coordinate interfaces with Messe Zurich, suppliers, authorities, and teams such as Program, F&B and Partnerships.
  • Track tasks, dependencies, deadlines, risks and budget, escalating early when decisions are needed.
  • Lead on site during setup, event days and teardown, solving problems pragmatically and supporting your team.
  • Capture learnings, build repeatable processes and documentation, and strengthen the area for future editions.

Requirements

  • Experience in events, production, operations, logistics or facility management, ideally with on-site responsibility.
  • Previous team leadership experience in an event, club, student organization, project or similar context.
  • Strong coordination skills and the ability to keep many moving parts in view.
  • A calm, practical approach when plans change or something goes wrong.
  • Proactive communication and willingness to raise risks early.
  • Confident communication in German and English.
  • Experience with Swiss venues, permits or authorities is a plus.
  • Willingness to join the 2026 event to see the setup and handover live is strongly preferred.

Benefits

  • Real ownership of a critical festival area and the chance to build its setup at a new venue.
  • A proper handover through Startup Nights 2026 (5-6 November, Eulachhallen Winterthur), ideally joining the team on site.
  • Direct access to founders, investors, corporates and other key players in the Swiss startup ecosystem.
  • A driven team with short decision paths and meaningful responsibility.
  • Team weekend and shared team events throughout the year.
  • Leadership experience plus a volunteer/work certificate for your CV.
  • A chance to help shape the Swiss startup ecosystem through a non-profit initiative.

This is a volunteer leadership role. Commitment varies by phase: regular planning during the year, a higher cadence in the weeks before the event, and full availability during setup, event days and teardown. We are looking for at least the 2027 edition, ideally several editions beyond.

Apply through the JOIN application form and tell us briefly why you want to take on the role and which events, operations or infrastructure projects you have led. We review applications on a rolling basis. If you are a good fit, we will invite you to a short conversation and, where possible, introduce you to the team at Startup Nights 2026.

You want to help protect western values? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure – ultimately saving the lives of thousands.

Join us at CDDS to bring next‑generation control, guidance, and state‑estimation algorithms into high-speed kinetic interceptor drones.

We are looking for a Senior Vision & Perception Engineer to architect and optimise our low-latency vision pipeline running on NVIDIA Jetson platforms. You will develop, tune, and extend DeepStream-based pipelines in C++, integrate differential-imaging workflows, and ensure end‑to‑end real‑time performance.

  • Implement and optimize vision pipelines in C++ for low-latency object detection and tracking

  • Optimise TensorRT inference performance
  • Profile and tune performance down to kernel-level bottlenecks
  • Maintain GPU-accelerated development containers and CI pipelines

Requirements

Your Profile

  • MSc/PhD in Computer Vision, Robotics, CS, or similar
  • Expert knowledge in DeepStream, GStreamer, and low-level video pipelines
  • Strong C++ skills and experience with CUDA, TensorRT, or Jetson optimisation
  • Strong background in modern detection models (YOLO, EfficientDet, etc.)
  • Experience with ROS2 and multi-process robotic systems
  • Comfortable with rapid field-testing cycles and high‑ownership environments

  • Attractive compensation

Details

Location: Schlieren (Zürich), on‑site

Start date: ASAP

Environment: High‑impact deep‑tech startup working on real deployments
